t: ORF1ab - Wikipedia
s: September 6, 2025 - A set of five conserved "core replicase" protein domains are present in all nidovirus lineages (arteriviruses, mesoniviruses, roniviruses, and coronaviruses): from ORF1a, the main protease flanked on either end by transmembrane domains; and from ORF1b, a nucleotidyltransferase domain known as NiRAN, RNA-dependent RNA polymerase (RdRp), a zinc-binding domain, and a helicase.

t: ORF 1 - Wikipedia
s: January 16, 2026 - ORF 1 (ORF eins, Österreichischer Rundfunk 1) is an Austrian public television channel owned by ORF. It was the first television channel in Austria, started in 1955, with regular programming started in 1957 when it now operated six days a week, then began broadcasting every day in 1961.
